title: Human starting area: Northshire Valley
content: Humans start in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. All class trainers are in and around Northshire Abbey, the big building in the middle of the valley. When you leave the valley, the first town is Goldshire, with an inn, vendors and more trainers. The capital is Stormwind City, north-west of Goldshire. After Elwynn Forest most humans go to Westfall around level 10.

title: Dwarf and gnome starting area: Coldridge Valley
content: Dwarves and gnomes start in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. The class trainers are in and around Anvilmar, the stone building in the valley. Go through the tunnel to reach the town of Kharanos, which has an inn, vendors and trainers. The capital is Ironforge, further east in Dun Morogh. After Dun Morogh most go to Loch Modan around level 10.

title: Night elf starting area: Shadowglen
content: Night elves start in Shadowglen on Teldrassil. The class trainers are in Aldrassil, the huge tree in the middle of Shadowglen; walk up the ramp inside it. The first town is Dolanaar. The capital is Darnassus on the west side of Teldrassil. Around level 10 night elves take the boat from Rut'theran Village to Darkshore.

title: Orc and troll starting area: Valley of Trials
content: Orcs and trolls start in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. The class trainers are in and around the Den, the big hut and camp in the middle of the valley. The first town is Razor Hill, east of the valley, with an inn, vendors and trainers. The capital is Orgrimmar, north in Durotar. Around level 10 most go west into The Barrens to the Crossroads.

title: Tauren starting area: Camp Narache
content: Tauren start at Camp Narache in Mulgore. The class trainers are in the tents of Camp Narache. The first town is Bloodhoof Village, north-east of the camp. The capital is Thunder Bluff, on the mesas in northern Mulgore. Around level 10 tauren head east into The Barrens to the Crossroads.

title: Undead starting area: Deathknell
content: The Forsaken start in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. The class trainers are in the buildings and the chapel of Deathknell. The first town is Brill, east along the road, with an inn and trainers. The capital is the Undercity, under the ruins of Lordaeron east of Brill. Around level 10 most go to Silverpine Forest.

title: How class trainers work
content: Every class has a class trainer in its race's starting area, in the first towns and in the capital cities. You can learn new spells and ranks every even level (2, 4, 6 and so on), and it costs a little money. Talents start at level 10. Weapon skill trainers for new weapon types are in the capitals. If you cannot find a trainer, ask a guard; guards show the way on the map.

title: Riding and mounts on this server
content: On this server riding works like this: Apprentice Riding at level 20 costs 4 gold at your race's riding trainer, and a normal mount (60% speed) from the vendor next to the trainer costs about 1 gold, so about 5 gold in total. Journeyman Riding (epic, 100% speed) comes at level 40 and costs 50 gold, plus about 10 gold for an epic mount. Nobody pays 50 gold for the first mount here. Players save up for the epic one and often farm or sell crafted items to afford it.

title: Professions basics
content: You can have two main professions, for example mining and blacksmithing, herbalism and alchemy, or skinning and leatherworking. Gathering pairs well with a crafting profession or makes good money on the auction house. Cooking, fishing and first aid are secondary and everyone can learn them. Profession trainers are in the starting towns and the capitals.

title: Ragefire Chasm (levels 13-18)
content: Ragefire Chasm is a five-player dungeon for about levels 13-18. It is in inside Orgrimmar (Horde). Groups usually want a tank, a healer and three damage dealers.

title: Which dungeon for my level
content: Rough guide: Ragefire Chasm 13-18, Wailing Caverns and Deadmines 17-26, Shadowfang Keep 22-30, Blackfathom Deeps and the Stockade 24-32, Gnomeregan 29-38, Razorfen Kraul 30-40, Scarlet Monastery 34-45, Razorfen Downs 40-50, Uldaman 42-52, Zul'Farrak 44-54, Maraudon 46-55, Sunken Temple 50-60, then Blackrock Depths, Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Stratholme and Scholomance at 55-60.

title: Horde leveling zones
content: Typical Horde path: starting zone 1-10, The Barrens 10-25, Stonetalon Mountains 15-27, Ashenvale 18-30, Hillsbrad Foothills 20-30, Thousand Needles 25-35, Desolace 30-40, Stranglethorn Vale 30-45, Arathi Highlands 30-40, Dustwallow Marsh 35-45, Badlands 35-45, Tanaris 40-50, Feralas 40-50, the Hinterlands 40-50, Searing Gorge 43-50, Felwood 48-55, Un'Goro Crater 48-55, Burning Steppes 50-58, Winterspring 55-60, Western and Eastern Plaguelands 51-60.

title: Alliance leveling zones
content: Typical Alliance path: starting zone 1-10, Westfall, Loch Modan or Darkshore 10-20, Redridge Mountains 15-25, Duskwood 18-30, Wetlands 20-30, Ashenvale 18-30, Hillsbrad Foothills 20-30, Stranglethorn Vale 30-45, Arathi Highlands 30-40, Desolace 30-40, Dustwallow Marsh 35-45, Badlands 35-45, Tanaris 40-50, Feralas 40-50, the Hinterlands 40-50, Searing Gorge 43-50, Felwood 48-55, Un'Goro Crater 48-55, Burning Steppes 50-58, Winterspring 55-60, Western and Eastern Plaguelands 51-60.

title: Who rules the cities: faction leaders
content: Stormwind: the king has been missing for years, so the boy king Anduin Wrynn sits on the throne in Stormwind Keep, with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon ruling as regent and Lady Katrana Prestor at his side. Ironforge: King Magni Bronzebeard. Darnassus: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Gnomes: High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, in Ironforge since Gnomeregan fell. Orgrimmar: Warchief Thrall. Thunder Bluff: Cairne Bloodhoof. Undercity: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Darkspear trolls: Vol'jin, in Orgrimmar. Theramore: Lady Jaina Proudmoore.
